text: It is raining. If it is raining, the ground is wet. Is the ground wet?
Alice is a student. All students are people. All people need sleep. Does Alice need sleep?
Birds can fly. Penguins are birds, but penguins cannot fly. Tweety is a penguin. Can Tweety fly?
notes: non-monotonic exception; the more specific penguin default wins

text: A sedan is a car. A car is a motor vehicle. Is a sedan a motor vehicle?
Vehicle X has an engine, four wheels, 150 horsepower and four doors. What type of vehicle is X?
notes: abduction; class rules are not in the text

text: Machine M has a power of 150 kilowatts and four wheels. Any machine with power of at least 50 kilowatts and at least four wheels is a car. Is M a car?
Company policy: every employee must wear a badge in the building. John is an employee. Must John wear a badge in the building?
notes: deontic obligation as a typed modality

text: All dogs are mammals. Rex is a dog. Rex is not a mammal. Is Rex a mammal?
notes: theory entails P and not-P; target-related contradiction reported

text: Socrates is a man. All men are mortal. Given that Socrates is a philosopher, is Socrates mortal?
A whale is a mammal. All mammals are warm-blooded. A whale lives in water. Any warm-blooded animal that lives in water is an aquatic mammal. Is a whale an aquatic mammal?
Birds cannot fly. Penguins can fly. Tweety is a penguin. Can Tweety fly?
notes: specificity wins in the positive direction

text: Quakers are pacifists. Republicans are not pacifists. Nixon is a quaker and a republican. Is Nixon a pacifist?
notes: Nixon diamond; equal specificity stays unknown

text: Все люди смертны. Сократ — человек. При условии, что Сократ — философ, смертен ли Сократ?
notes: RU explicit presupposition is a question condition (Gamma)

text: All men are mortal. Socrates is a man. Socrates is a philosopher, is Socrates mortal?
notes: comma declarative is read as a descriptive fact, so the answer stays definite
